messages:
Asha (People Ops): quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: hybrid/travel ops — drop clarifying Qs here
Liam P.: Are hub day passes required if I'm in town for a 1-day offsite and only need desks for a day?
Asha (People Ops): Book a hub day pass and choose 'Visitor/Offsite' if not on hub roster. Day passes are covered for official offsites. See https://redwood.internal/hubs
Diego (Facilities): If you need evening building access, add that request on the booking 48h in advance so we can arrange security.
Nora G.: Can teams tag an event on the hub calendar so security/Facilities knows it's a team event?
Diego (Facilities): Yes — tag 'Offsite - Team' and include an onsite lead name + phone.
Liam P.: Is it OK to mix a private rental (social) + office hub (workshop) across the same offsite?
Asha (People Ops): Yes. Submit one offsite form with day-by-day plan and attach venue invoices and host cancellation policy.
Maya (Finance): Reminder: use expense code EXP-OFFSITE, submit receipts in Concur within 30 days. For large deposits we can direct-bill vendors with an invoice.
Liam P.: For international teammates coming in, do we need to add them to the hub roster or provide passport names?
Asha (People Ops): Add visiting attendee list to the hub booking and include passport/legal name if a temp pass is needed. For visa letters, request 8+ weeks out.
Liam P.: Any quick tips for keeping meal costs reasonable but still good for team morale?
Kate L. (CEO): Shared meals and local catering often hit the balance. If you need higher spend for a programmatic reason, include rationale in the form and we'll review.
Asha (People Ops): If anyone wants a pre-submit review of an offsite plan, paste the offsite form URL here and we'll take a look. :party_parrot:
